2607.05292.title: Air Quality Downscaling with Station-Guided Pseudo-Supervision
2607.05292.paper_summary: Super-resolving coarse atmospheric fields to local PM$_{2.5}$ variations is uniquely challenged by a mismatch in spatial support: while pixels represent regional averages, ground-truth observations are discrete, unaligned samples of a continuous spatial signal. To bridge this gap, we present a station-guided framework for high-resolution PM$_{2.5}$ downscaling over Europe. Taking coarse CAMS atmospheric composition fields alongside heterogeneous side information (i.e., human activity, land cover, elevation, satellite aerosol observations, and wind fields) our framework jointly super-resolves ($\times 40$, $\approx$ 1 km) and bias-corrects CAMS rasters, without relying on temporal sequence modelling. To address the challenge of densely supervising our multi-scale transformer network with sparse in-situ data, we introduce a time-agnostic propagation strategy that utilises spatial Gaussian blending of interpolated OpenAQ observations. Extensive qualitative and station-level evaluations across Europe demonstrate that our model recovers fine-grained spatial structures and effectively mitigates localised CAMS biases.
2607.05292.paper_summary_zh: 超解析粗糙的大氣場以應對當地 PM$_{2.5}$ 變化面臨著空間支持不匹配的獨特挑戰：雖然像素代表區域平均值，但地面真實觀測則是連續空間信號的離散、不對齊樣本。為了彌補這一差距，我們提出了一個以站點為指導的高解析度 PM$_{2.5}$ 下調整框架，涵蓋整個歐洲。我們的框架同時超解析（$\times 40$, $\approx$ 1 公里）和偏差校正 CAMS 栅格，利用粗糙的 CAMS 大氣成分場以及異質的側信息（即，人類活動、土地覆蓋、高度、衛星氣溶膠觀測和風場），而無需依賴時間序列建模。為了解決用稀疏的現場數據密集監督我們的多尺度Transformer網絡的挑戰，我們引入了一種時間無關的傳播策略，利用插值的 OpenAQ 觀測的空間高斯混合。廣泛的定性和站點級別評估顯示，我們的模型能夠恢復細緻的空間結構，並有效減輕當地的 CAMS 偏差。
